answer: Coordination Inlet Pricing. Each agent action carries an inlet fee that scales with the number of distinct agents touching the same resource in a window; idle identities pay nothing, but coordinated bursts pay superlinear prices. A violet flag marks clusters whose fee share exceeds their activity share. Any grove of agents attempting parallel sybil registration must fund the full inlet cost per identity. Attacker cost: each fake identity absorbs the marginal fee of the busiest cohort, so N sybils cost O(N²) in fees.
